AbsenceRecord.description:
A live directory fact. Recording an absence does not move existing work
or grant the cover any source authority.

ClockPolicy.description: The serialized form of [`ClockPolicy`]: the shape the serializer emits.

DecisionKind.description:
A reviewer's decision. Every decision names a declared outcome. A missing
`outcome` reads as empty so the policy check refuses it with the outcomes
the policy declares for that decision, rather than as an unreadable body;
the published schema still requires the field.

oneOf.description:
Approval names an approved outcome. It carries no private reason or
result, which approved outcomes cannot require.

Digest.description: A SHA-256 digest: `sha256:` followed by 64 lowercase hex digits.

DirectoryMember.description:
A directory-scoped presentation of a person. The optional name belongs to
one team membership and never enters accountable actor identity.

ExternalId.description: An identifier another system issues, written exactly as its issuer gives it.

HolidaySetDocument.description: One live, revisioned holiday set supplied separately from deployed policy.

InputDecisionKind.description:
A reviewer's decision. Every decision names a declared outcome. A missing
`outcome` reads as empty so the policy check refuses it with the outcomes
the policy declares for that decision, rather than as an unreadable body;
the published schema still requires the field.

oneOf.description:
Approval names an approved outcome. It carries no private reason or
result, which approved outcomes cannot require.

InputDirectoryMember.description:
A directory-scoped presentation of a person. The optional name belongs to
one team membership and never enters accountable actor identity.

InputHolidaySetDocument.description: One live, revisioned holiday set supplied separately from deployed policy.

InputIssuerPrincipal.description: A person is qualified by the issuer that authenticated the subject.

InputPolicySelection.description:
Select the trusted provider's current policy, or require one exact binding.
The selector stays in the submission identity; acceptance records the concrete binding.

InputReviewTaskOwnership.description:
Select active review tasks by their current holder. Selection never grants
reviewer eligibility or source authority.

IssuerPrincipal.description: A person is qualified by the issuer that authenticated the subject.

LocalId.description: A local identifier: a lowercase letter, then up to 63 lowercase letters, digits, `_`, or `-`.

OwnReviewDecision.description: A current caller's retained decision reference, without context or reason.

detail.const: Choose cover assignments that do not return to an earlier person during a shared period.
Set until later than from.
Adjust the period so this person has no overlapping absence.
Choose a different staff member as cover.
The bearer credential is missing, invalid, or expired. Sign in again.
Create a new recompute preview and review it before applying.
This cursor has expired. Start again without a cursor and deduplicate entries by eventId.
The cursor is invalid for this request.

Your current Casework authority does not allow this operation.
The item or directory changed since you loaded it. Reload and try again.
This mutation requires the revision that you loaded.

This action is reserved for a human session.
The request body exceeds the one MiB limit.

decisionReceipt.description:
Unavailable for legacy selections no longer retained when upgraded.
New selections are retained through the accountability window.

oneOf.description:
A subject clock covers one request. The correlation names the subject
the request reviews; the budget is the request's own, and a
resubmission starts a new one.

id.description: The producer-issued contract id, kept exactly as written: nonblank, no control characters, and at most 256 UTF-8 bytes. The byte ceiling is enforced by the Casework reader.

ReviewDecisionReceipt.description:
A retained decision, interpreted under the task's pinned policy and released
through an own receipt or the explicit audited accountability read.
Private reasons and structured producer result data are never included.

outcomeLabel.description: The configured label from the decision's immutable pinned policy.

publicReason.description:
Whether a decision with this outcome gives text for release to the
subject's owner. There is no default: the policy author decides what
an applicant is told.

ReviewPolicyDependencies.description:
Complete behavioral inputs retained beside an admitted request. Live Directory
membership and absence facts remain current authority, not policy inputs.

initiatorProfile.description:
The requester profile a person named as this producer's initiator
authenticates with to read the requester-visible history of their own
requests. Absent, no initiator reads anything.

ReviewPublicReasonRule.description: Whether a decision gives a public reason with an outcome.

publicReason.description:
Text the decision gives for release to the subject's owner. It is
distinct from the reviewer's private reason, which never leaves
Casework.

display.description:
Exact source values from the current human caller's read, limited by
the authored source context projection and the pinned kind schema.

decidedByCaller.description:
Whether the current caller recorded this task's decision. Present only
on a single decided-task read, so a reviewer whose decide response was
lost can confirm the outcome without learning who else decided.

decisionReceipt.description:
Present only on a single decided-task read when `decidedByCaller` is
true. Current task eligibility, membership, source disclosure, and
result retention still apply.

staffingDiagnostic.description: Present when an assignment or absence recompute found no eligible cover.

nextCursor.description:
Pass unchanged with the same caller, profiles and filters. A cursor
after an undisclosed candidate is an opaque expiring scan checkpoint,
not a task identifier.

status.description:
Whether the page stopped early: `budget-exhausted` when the source-read
budget, candidate scan, or page deadline ran out before the page
filled, and `source-unavailable` when a bound source did not answer in
time. Either comes with a `nextCursor` to continue from.

RoutingPredicate.description:
The written form of [`RoutingPredicate`], an externally tagged union the
shared reader decodes with positions.

oneOf.description: The projected field equals this value.
The projected field equals one of these values.

SchedulingTaskPermission.description:
Exact Scheduling commitment authority copied into a task grant.

This duplicates the public wire shape deliberately: Casework is an
authority for governed templates, not a dependency on Scheduling's runtime
or model crate.

SupervisoryReviewTask.description: A task reference without reviewer identity, content, or decision data.

staffingDiagnostic.description: Bounded staffing status without holder or absence identities.

nextCursor.description:
Pass unchanged with the same caller, profiles and queue. A cursor
after an undisclosed candidate is an opaque expiring scan checkpoint,
not a task identifier.

SupervisoryReviewTaskState.description:
Operational discovery for a current supervisor of the task's serving team.
This reference grants neither review eligibility nor access to task content.

TaskAssertionResponse.description: Short-lived credential response. Deliberately does not implement Debug.

TaskAuthorityJwks.description: JSON Web Key Set of the configured task authority's public verification keys.

TaskGrantBounds.description:
The product-specific authority a task grant carries, chosen by its `type`
member. The shared reader's union helper decodes it so every error inside
a variant keeps its position (CFG-SCHEMA-8); the wire form is unchanged.

TaskGrantStatus.description: Fresh status returned only to the service client registered for this resource.

TaskGrantView.description:
Grant metadata. Stored subjects are deliberately absent: preview and approval
derive selectors from the caller's current disclosed source representation.

authorizationMode.description:
Immediate authorizations last at most fifteen minutes. Deferred is an
explicit governed window of at most seven days; assertion TTL stays sixty seconds.

Immediate authorizations last at most fifteen minutes. Deferred is an
explicit governed window of at most seven days; assertion TTL stays sixty seconds.

evidenceContext.description:
Evidence-only requester context signed into the authority assertion.
Other products derive neither requester admission nor relying-party
audience from these fields and therefore forbid the block entirely.

reviewPolicies.description: Policies whose currently held ReviewTasks may issue this grant.

subjects.description:
Exact token identity keys mapped to governed source logical fields.
Values are extracted from the approving caller's disclosed source read.

authorizationMode.description:
Immediate authorizations last at most fifteen minutes. Deferred is an
explicit governed window of at most seven days; assertion TTL stays sixty seconds.

TemplateAgent.description:
The agent a template names, as `casework.yaml` writes it: the issuer is
the URL of the token issuer that authenticates the agent (CFG-VAL-7).

Url.description: An absolute http or https URL with a host preserved as written, no user information, and no backslash, whitespace or control character. DNS case and equivalent IPv6 literals are permitted.

bearerAuth.description: Exact trusted-issuer identity and governed scopes. A producer token grants no human review authority.

info.description: Source-neutral review policies, requests, human decisions, and immutable results. Context providers and downstream grant authority remain independent trust boundaries.
